name: Orrery
desc: A luminous clockwork cosmos where a warm radial sun anchors jewel-hued planets sweeping elliptical orbits ringed in glowing brass, with moons, a long-tailed comet, and slowly rotating armillary bands over a deep nebula-lit starfield.

scale.doc: orbit spread (higher = orbits sweep wider, filling the frame)

energy.doc: glow/exposure amplitude of sun, planets and rings

hue.doc: base ring/sun hue (nebula tint drifts off it)
